snippet.title: Undercards - Season 116 Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer by  ⁨@sktima⁩  

DISCLAIMER: Test server gameplay. Stats and effects may not represent their final versions.

Thumbnail art by Jaimeeznuts

Official trailer for Undercards' Season 116 update with over 80 balance changes, Story Mode update, a brand new mechanic and 3 new cards!

Undercards is a multiplayer card game based on the works of Toby Fox (Undertale and Deltarune) as well as Undertale Yellow by MasterSword.

Play the game at undercards.net
#undertale #deltarune #undercards 

Music used:
Toby Fox - Snowy (Undertale OST)
GameChops - Bonetrousle (Holder Remix)
MasterSwordRemix - Blizzard Approaching (Undertale Yellow)
